_GeneralInformation.Description: The models in this dataset are based on version 5.1 of the Hazus Hurricane Model Technical Manual.

W.SF - Wood, Single-family: W.SF.2 - Wood, Single-family, Two or More Stories.

W.MUH.3 - Wood, Multi-Unit Housing, Three or More Stories.
